statements.t: The following measures are used by the Company’s management to evaluate financial performance against historical results and establish targets on a consolidated basis.
Internally, the Company's management uses the measures to evaluate performance against historical results, to establish financial targets on a consolidated basis and for other reasons.

• Annualized sales: Annualized sales are based on the total yearly premium that the Company would expect to receive if all first year recurring premium policies would remain in force, plus 10% of single and indexed universal life excess premiums.
